statement: Let G(x, u) satisfy the analytic and transversality hypotheses of Lemma 9.1. Suppose that the zero family admits a proper holomorphic map b : M → {G = 0} over the parameter disk such that 1. q : M → D is a smooth family; 2. b is an isomorphism away from the origin section; 3. E = b−1({x = 0}) is a relative normal-crossing divisor. 25 Here the last condition means that, in local coordinates consisting of fiber coordinates and u, the support of E is a union of coordinate hyperplanes in the fiber coordinates. Then G has the trivialization of Lemma 9.1.
